about: Fifteen Days v6, third round: the robot brings the menus with all three at the table (Deluin kept). DRAFTED prompt.

jobs.prompt: Keep both seated people of picture 1 exactly where they are: the young woman with the magenta ponytail seated on the left of the table, and the tall young man in the cream cable-knit tunic seated on the right of the table, now both with small closed-mouth smiles, looking up. Add the young man from picture 2 (spiky black hair with one blue streak, orange cropped zip jacket over a black top), standing at the near left end of the table, pulling out a chair to sit down, drawn once. Add the serving robot: a machine, not a person: a rounded white head with a dark face screen showing two small kind glowing eyes, slim white shoulders and jointed arms holding a flat tray, and no legs: below the waist a smooth white column down to a round gliding base, small, gliding up behind the table in the background between the young woman and the tall young man, holding out a tray with two small glowing menu tablets. Keep picture 1's drawing, colours, courtyard, lights and camera exactly. Exactly three people and one robot. No letters or numbers anywhere.
